rows.what_the_ink_shows: At the opening u:A' -> A, the distinct prime follows the left A before the rightward arrow; the target A has no prime (crops/14_scan080_L265_opening.jpg). The top-degree map visibly has H^{2n}(A) at left and H^{2n}(A') at right (crops/14_scan080_L265_top_degree.jpg). The image condition visibly reads u(A') != A, again with the prime inside the left parentheses (crops/14_scan080_L265_image_condition.jpg). The later displayed u_* has H^*(A) at left and H^*(A') at right (crops/14_scan080_L265_transpose.jpg), and the unit formula reads u_0(1_A)=d.1_{A'}, with a rounded zero subscript on u and the prime on the right-hand A (crops/14_scan080_L265_unit.jpg). The shifted map likewise places A at left and A' at right (crops/14_scan080_L265_shifted.jpg), whereas the later u^1 has H^1(A') at left and H^1(A) at right (crops/14_scan080_L265_pullback.jpg).
rows.note: Written: u:A' -> A; top-degree pullback H^{2n}(A) -> H^{2n}(A'); image condition u(A') != A. Later written maps and unit formula use the opposite source/target convention. The supplied correction intends u:A -> A' from the outset, with the top-degree map reversed and the image condition changed to u(A) != A', while retaining the later convention. The prime marks in the opening, top-degree map, and image condition are unmistakable: this is an inconsistency in the author's notation rather than a transcription misreading. Preserve all text, including the original u_0 unit notation and existing unrelated doubts. The row's references to scans 81–85 were not inspected.
